subject: Scoring proposal & eval-mode alignment for Medicore trial
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Scoring proposal & eval-mode alignment for Medicore trial

Hi Emily / Tom —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap and a concrete proposal to keep momentum on the trial planning we discussed. I captured what's most important for Medicore and our recommended evaluation approach.

Key goals you flagged:
- Reduce false-positive classification on patient-intake forms by 40% within trial window
- Maintain sub-500ms median latency for real-time triage flows
- Keep per-token inference cost predictable for production planning

Proposed trial structure (high level):
1) 3-week shadow run (real traffic, no user-visible actions) to validate latency and safety thresholds
2) 2-week offline grading pass using a 500-case blinded test set to validate accuracy and edge-case handling
3) Acceptance gate: >=40% reduction in FP rate OR no regression on any high-severity class, and median latency <=500ms

Why shadow first?
- Shadow lets us measure real distribution and latency under load with low risk to users.
- Offline grading provides repeatable, explainable metrics for procurement and clinical QA.

Attached: draft_scoring_matrix.xlsx (proposed rubric), trial_schedule.csv (timeline + ownership), shadow-vs-offline-onepager.pdf (short decision guide).

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Can you confirm the primary KPI to prioritize for acceptance: FP reduction vs overall F1?
- Are there any compliance constraints (PII redaction) we should enforce during shadow?
- Preferred kickoff date: week of Dec 7?

I'll loop in Marissa to coordinate the runbook and Ben to scope infra / cost estimates.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Scoring proposal & eval-mode alignment for Medicore trial

Vanessa —

Appreciate the clear recap. This aligns with what we need. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) KPI: prioritize false-positive reduction for intake triage (FP reduction). Secondary: precision/recall trade-offs and latency.
2) Compliance: we must pseudonymize PHI before sending to any third party. Can Redwood support field-level tokenization or do we need to push that pre-ingest?
3) Kickoff: Dec 8 is tight but acceptable. Can we target Dec 9 to give our infra team an extra day?

On the scoring rubric: we'll review the draft and send comments by EOD Wed. For the offline set, we'll supply 500 de-identified cases as discussed.

Thanks,
Emily Chen
Director of Product, Medicore Health
emily.chen@medicore.com

Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Scoring proposal & eval-mode alignment for Medicore trial — ownership + action items

Team — fwd'ing Emily's reply. Summary of what they confirmed and owners we need: 

Owners proposed:
- Marissa: trial runbook + compliance checks (pseudonymization workflow, audit hooks)
- Ben: infra sizing + estimate for dedicated shadow capacity; cost delta for enabling pseudonymization pre-ingest
- Jonas: scoring rubric finalization, offline grading harness, and acceptance gate automation

Immediate actions (this week):
- Marissa: draft runbook with steps for shadow traffic injection and data handling by Thu EOD
- Ben: provide cost ballpark and whether we need dedicated capacity by Thu EOD
- Jonas: merge Medicore inputs into draft_scoring_matrix.xlsx and return for our review by Wed EOD

Notes on methodology (for alignment):
- Shadow: measure latency, tail conditions, and real distribution error modes. No model roll-forward during shadow unless safety gates pass.
- Offline: blinded graders (combination of clinician reviewers + automated checks). Proposed rubric includes severity-weighted false positives and a calibration penalty.

Please reply inline with any feasibility blockers. I’ll consolidate and send the external confirmation once we have these artifacts.

Thanks,
Vanessa

Subject: Re: Fwd: Scoring proposal & eval-mode alignment for Medicore trial — ownership + action items

Vanessa / team —

Acknowledged. I'll take lead on the runbook and compliance checklist. Quick notes from an ops perspective: 

- Pseudonymization: We can accept de-identified cases, but for shadow we will need a one-way tokenization layer in their VPC connector. I'll draft two options: (A) Medicore tokenizes before sending (recommended) and (B) Redwood applies a reversible tokenization within their VPC (requires HSM/KMS config).
- Shadow traffic approach: 10% sample of live intake traffic routed to shadow cluster during week 1, then 25% in week 2 for stress checks, full sampling in week 3 if no major issues.
- Acceptance automation: we'll produce a nightly grading run to compute the rubric metrics and push a summary dashboard to the shared Drive link.

Deliverables and deadlines I'm committing to:
- Runbook + compliance checklist (Thu 03 Dec, 5pm PT)
- Access instructions for Medicore infra team to connect to shadow endpoint (Fri 04 Dec)

Marissa

Emily / Tom —

Confirming next steps and kickoff date of Dec 9. Below is an agreed summary and immediate asks before the call.

Agreed trial plan:
- Week of Dec 9: connectivity, config, and smoke testing (no live shadow yet)
- Week of Dec 16–22: 3-week shadow run (gradual ramp 10% -> 25% -> 100% sampling)
- Week of Jan 6–10: offline blinded grading (Medicore supplies 500 de-identified cases)
- Acceptance review: Jan 12 (decision meeting)

Accepted success gate: primary = >=40% FP reduction on intake triage; secondary checks = no high-severity regressions and median latency <=500ms.

Pre-kickoff asks (please provide by Tue, Dec 7):
- Medicore: confirmed de-id process + contact for infra handoff (who will be joining kickoff?)
- Redwood: Ben will share a baseline cost estimate and shadow endpoint details; Marissa will circulate the runbook draft and pseudonymization options. Jonas will upload the updated scoring rubric to the Drive link.

Links & attachments: 
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/contacts/MD-2026-089
- Shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4_med_trial_docs
- Attachments (same as earlier): draft_scoring_matrix.xlsx, trial_schedule.csv, shadow-vs-offline-onepager.pdf

If no objections, I'll schedule the Dec 9 kickoff 30-minute sync and invite the technical contacts.

See you next week —
